We're looking for a Staff Data Scientist, Pricing to build the analytical and machine learning capability that pricing runs on, from demand modelling through to the systems that recommend price. You won't be starting from zero. We've invested in the foundational data and infrastructure that pricing decisions depend on. What's missing is the capability on top: models the business trusts, experiments that settle pricing questions with evidence, and economics defined once so they hold consistently across Commercial, Product and the customer experience. The arc of the role runs from measurement to prediction to prescription - understanding how demand responds to price, forecasting how it will respond, and ultimately building the models that recommend the price itself. What You'll Do: Build and own the demand and elasticity modelling capability, quantifying how price affects volume across destination, duration, data tier, and customer segment. Develop machine learning models for demand forecasting and willingness-to-pay, and take them from exploration through to production with the monitoring and retraining that keeps them honest. Move us from predictive to prescriptive by building the optimisation layer that turns forecasts and elasticities into recommended prices under margin, competitive and partner constraints. Design and analyse pricing experiments with statistical rigour, and apply causal methods where clean randomisation isn't possible. Define pricing within our data ecosystem, owning the governed definitions of price, cost and package economics that reporting, analysis and product surfaces all read from. Partner with Commercial and Finance to connect pricing decisions to margin and revenue, and to size opportunities before we commit. Set the analytical standard for pricing at Airalo, from what counts as evidence through to how a model or recommendation gets validated before it influences live pricing. What You'll Bring: 7+ years in data science, quantitative economics, or applied research, including pricing, monetisation, or marketplace economics work that demonstrably changed decisions. Experience with dynamic or algorithmic pricing systems in production. An advanced degree in Econometrics, Statistics, Operations Research or similar, or equivalent applied depth in demand estimation and the identification problems that make naive price-quantity regressions wrong. Hands-on machine learning experience across the full lifecycle, from feature engineering and model selection through to deployment Familiarity with optimisation and decision-science methods that turn predictions into recommended actions, whether through constrained optimisation, bandits, or reinforcement learning approaches. Proven experimentation expertise, having designed and defended experiments with a clear view on decision frameworks and common failure modes. Experience building analytical capability where none existed before, turning raw data and a business question into something a commercial team uses repeatedly. Strong data modelling instincts, thinking in reusable definitions and single sources of truth rather than standalone analyses. The ability to move comfortably between financial, product and operational data and connect the analysis to a financial outcome. Genuine partnership instincts, translating between analytical rigour and commercial reality so that Commercial and Product come to you early rather than after the decision. Fluency in the Python ML stack alongside strong SQL, with the engineering hygiene to hand over code that others can run and maintain. Excellent communication skills, including the ability to make a methodological argument to people who won't check your standard errors. A self-starter mindset that thrives in ambiguity and brings structure without waiting for permission. Comfort using AI tools to augment analytical work, with a point of view on where they help and where they don't Nice to have: Experience in marketplace, telecom, travel, or subscription/usage-based businesses. Bayesian or hierarchical modelling for sparse segments and long-tail SKUs. Competitive price response modelling, or working with scraped competitor pricing data. Familiarity with dbt, LightDash, or similar semantic/BI layers. Experience designing semantic or metric layers consumed by both analytics and production systems. Experience working in cross-functional teams spanning commercial, finance and product disciplines. If you are interested in this position, please apply via the link. title: Staff Tech Lead, Web & Developer Products
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Our everyday digital experiences are in the middle of a realtime revolution: chatting alongside a livestream, getting realtime financial updates, or working with colleagues in a shared online space. Consumers now expect realtime as standard, and Ably powers a large part of it.</p> <p>We put developers first. Our products help teams build, extend, and deliver realtime digital experiences, delivering over 700 billion messages to more than 2 billion devices every month. Teams at HubSpot, Fin, Dialpad, NASCAR, Sportsbet, and General Motors all build on Ably.</p> <p>Working at Ably means helping build the infrastructure that will shape the next generation of the internet. More of what people do online is becoming live, shared and interactive, which only makes what we build more relevant and more necessary. AI is the latest place that shows up. There's still so much to build, and we'd like your help with it.</p></div><h2><strong>About this role</strong></h2> <p>As the Staff Tech Lead for the Developer Experience team at Ably, you’ll report directly to our CTO and co-own the DevEx vision and strategy. You’ll lead the engineering team that owns our customer-facing web platform - our dashboard, documentation platform, and control plane - transforming it into a world-class experience for our users.</p> <p>You are a senior, hands-on engineer who’s passionate about building for developers like yourself; someone who’ll obsess over the developer journey and elevate the user experience of the Ably platform. You’ll blend deep full-stack expertise with a strong product mindset, and lead a team of engineers working on initiatives where the feedback loop is immediate, because you and your team are the target users of the very ecosystem you are building.</p> <p>Ably is an AI-forward organisation and this is a leadership role for an AI-first engineer. You must have confident, hands-on experience of AI-assisted development and be able to define how a team actually works with these tools day to day, and tell the difference between genuine leverage and noise.</p> <h2><strong>Day to day you will</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Obsess over developer experience. </strong>You’ll have broad responsibility for elevating how developers interact with Ably’s platform and services, partnering with the DevEx PM as a unified leadership team to deliver a developer experience that becomes a reference point for the industry.</li> <li><strong>Define and lead on AI-first working practices.</strong> You’ll be the catalyst and standard-setter for AI-enabled development across the team. You’ll leverage LLMs and AI tools to accelerate velocity, design workflows, set the guardrails and coach engineers to use them well - without compromising on engineering integrity.</li> <li><strong>Lead technical execution and vision.</strong> You’ll lead a team of five engineers building customer-facing web applications and own the technical architecture and design decisions for our dashboard, docs platform, marketing website, and billing UI.</li> <li><strong>Drive a product-first engineering culture.</strong> You’ll foster an environment where engineers are themselves principal stakeholders of product features, and obsess over customer outcomes. You’ll challenge the "feature factory" mentality and build a team that takes true ownership of the product.</li> <li><strong>Thrive in a rapid iteration environment.</strong> You’ll operate in a high-velocity workspace where PMs, customers, and engineers co-create features. You’ll lead the team in working full-stack to iterate, improve, and ship improvements quickly.</li> <li><strong>Guide engineering outcomes and quality.</strong> You’ll set and enforce high standards for code review, testing, and production readiness. You will participate in incident response and coordinate with the Infrastructure team on platform dependencies and deployments.</li> <li><strong>Mentor and grow the team.</strong> You’ll manage performance, career development, and hiring. You will hold the team accountable for delivery commitments while providing the mentorship needed to turn engineers into product-minded leaders.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>We'd love to talk if you have</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Real, demonstrable experience leading AI-first engineering. You champion the use of AI as a productivity multiplier for the team, and have led a team that ships with LLMs and AI tooling embedded in its daily workflow. You see AI as an enabler for higher velocity and output, not a replacement for engineering judgment, and hold strong, evidence-based views on what works and what doesn’t.</li> <li>Extensive experience leading technical teams in technical B2B SaaS or API-first products, with a track record of product-minded engineering teams that take initiative and ownership of product outcomes.</li> <li>A strong software engineering background with genuine full-stack fluency. You must have enough depth across the web stack to credibly lead and challenge senior web engineers. Hands-on experience with React and TypeScript is valuable, but sound engineering judgement and technical gravitas matter more than specific frameworks.</li> <li>You have a natural empathy and strong instincts for what developer customers want because you are the target user. You are genuinely excited about building developer tools and can tap into immediate feedback loops. description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Our everyday digital experiences are in the middle of a realtime revolution: chatting alongside a livestream, getting realtime financial updates, or working with colleagues in a shared online space. Consumers now expect realtime as standard, and Ably powers a large part of it.</p> <p>We put developers first. Our products help teams build, extend, and deliver realtime digital experiences, delivering over 700 billion messages to more than 2 billion devices every month. Teams at HubSpot, Fin, Dialpad, NASCAR, Sportsbet, and General Motors all build on Ably.</p> <p>Working at Ably means helping build the infrastructure that will shape the next generation of the internet. More of what people do online is becoming live, shared and interactive, which only makes what we build more relevant and more necessary. AI is the latest place that shows up. There's still so much to build, and we'd like your help with it.</p></div><h2><strong>About this role</strong></h2> <p>Thousands of developers around the world use Ably's SDKs and APIs to power realtime features in their applications. The Developer Experience team is responsible for ensuring that Ably is a platform that exemplifies great developer experience, and is a reference point that other companies aspire to.</p> <p>As our Senior Developer Experience Writer, you’ll be contributing directly to this goal; helping developers to quickly understand Ably, build confidently and ultimately succeed with the platform. At its core, this is an AI-focussed role; you’ll be in charge of  setting up the foundations that empower engineers to produce first-class developer documentation with AI at scale. You’ll use AI to automate checks, maintain quality, and allow for rapid iteration in the content itself, as well as in the documentation platform. You’ll still be setting the standards for technical content across the business, and using your expertise to shape the information architecture.</p> <p>This is a modern take on technical writing; you’ll be using AI to both increase your own output, whilst also increasing the velocity of other contributors. The same core values still apply though - ensuring that users can quickly understand and succeed with Ably.</p> <h2><strong>Day to day you will</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Use AI to produce quality content. </strong>You’ll write reusable prompts and skills that docs contributors can use to ensure their content meets Ably’s quality standards. </li> <li><strong>Define and uphold content standards</strong>. You'll help define what great looks like; from docs structure and style to making sure that PRs are always exceeding standards. You’ll leverage AI to check for technical accuracy, and make sure that content always assists developers in learning and succeeding with Ably in the fastest and easiest ways possible.</li> <li><strong>Build engaging educational content templates. </strong>You’ll lead by example by producing reference content that others can use as a pattern to write similar content. This will be in the format of templates and skills that team members can leverage.</li> <li><strong>Empower engineers to write great content</strong>. You'll coach and support engineering contributors to ensure that they’re always producing accurate, well-structured, developer-friendly content.</li> <li><strong>Champion effective AI use</strong>. You'll promote the use of AI for efficiency, while maintaining a sharp eye for quality ensuring content meets editorial standards, is technically accurate, and is free from AI-generated patterns that undermine trust or clarity.</li> <li><strong>Maintain and elevate the docs platform</strong>. You'll take responsibility for shaping the documentation platform's components, structure and tooling. This includes making sure content is logically structured, and easily navigable, and that it helps external developers understand Ably in new and exciting ways. </li> </ul> <h2><strong>We'd love to talk if you have</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Proven success creating technical content for developers, such as documentation, API references and guides; with a portfolio that others have visibly learned from.</li> <li>Experience reviewing and giving feedback on technical writing, with the ability to coach others to improve their craft.</li> <li>Experience and a desire to work in an AI-forward environment. Experience in automation, working with agents and producing quality content at scale is a bonus.</li> <li>Experience of using AI tools as a core part of your workflow for writing, research and coding, as well as understanding their output and limitations.</li> <li>Familiarity with APIs, SDKs, and modern web development tools, with the ability to read, write and reason about code examples in at least one programming language (ideally JavaScript).</li> <li>Strong instincts for developer experience, particularly around onboarding, and a genuine desire to produce experiences that delight developers.</li> <li>A proactive, self-directed mindset with the ability to take ownership of projects end to end, from ideation through to completion.</li> <li>Experience at a startup or growth-stage company, or the adaptability to thrive in a fast-paced, agile environment with a focus on rapid iteration, with excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Bonus points if you have</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Experience in maintaining and shaping a documentation platform or developer portal.</li> <li>Familiarity with information architecture principles and content strategy.</li> <li>Familiarity with git-driven workflows for managing content changes.</li> <li>Some knowledge or understanding of event-driven architecture.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h2><strong>What’s it like to work at Ably?</strong></h2> <p>You'll join a team of around 60 people, working directly alongside senior engineering and leadership. No layers, no bureaucracy, and real ownership from day one.</p> <h3>Remote-first</h3> <p>We hire the best people wherever they are across the UK and Europe, trust them to own their work, and share decisions and feedback openly. Twice a year, in February and August, we all meet in person, and we expect everyone to be there.</p> <p>Remote-first comes with trade-offs. On one side: flexibility, no commute, long stretches of focus time, and a wider pool of people to hire from. On the other: it can feel isolating, relationships take effort to build, and you miss the chance conversations an office creates. As our only recruiter, you'll need to manage your own time and stay close to the hiring managers and candidates you work with.</p> <p>If you do your best work with trust and autonomy, this will suit you. If you'd rather have an office around you every day, it probably isn't the right fit.</p> <p>Our six values shape how we work day to day:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Open for all.</strong> We default to sharing openly: source, decisions, and feedback, with open minds to match.</li> <li><strong>Tech needs humanity.</strong> We build with empathy, for colleagues and developers alike.</li> <li><strong>Even the best do better.</strong> We keep raising our own bar, driven by curiosity, not complacency.</li> <li><strong>Bias for action.</strong> Once we know enough to act, we act, rather than waiting for certainty.</li> <li><strong>Dependable by default.</strong> We take real ownership of what we ship and what we promise.</li> <li><strong>Bold creativity wins.</strong> We treat big constraints as a reason to think differently, not less.</li> </ul> <p>You can read more about how we defined these values on <a href="ably.com/blog/ably-values">our blog</a>, and see the team behind them on our <a href="ably.com/careers">careers page</a>.</p> <h2>Diversity, inclusion, and belonging at Ably</h2> <p>We believe our differences as individuals are what make us great. Our people are at the heart of what we do, and we encourage everyone to be their most authentic self at Ably: we see inclusivity and openness as fundamental to our long-term success. We encourage applications from all backgrounds regardless of age, disability, gender, sexual orientation, parental status, race, religion, educational background, or neurodiversity. Ably has an amazing opportunity ahead of us, and we want anyone to be able to contribute to it.</p> <p><em>If you enjoy working as part of a technology company, value open source, and love solving hard problems, we'd love to hear from you, regardless of whether you fit the job description exactly or not. If in doubt, drop us an <span style="font-weight: 400;"><a ----- target="_blank">email</a>;</span>; we're happy to give you advice on your application.</em></p> <h2>What you'll get</h2> <ul> <li>A remote-first and flexible work environment. Our London office (next to Old Street) is there whenever you want it. Aside from our company get-togethers, you're welcome to work wherever suits you best.</li> <li>Equity. We're a growing start-up, and we want everyone to share in the company's success through our EMI share options programme.</li> <li>Enhanced holiday allowance: 28 days of paid annual leave (27 regular days, plus a day off to enjoy your birthday).</li> <li>Enhanced parental leave, so you can spend time with your new family member: up to 16 weeks fully paid for primary caregivers and 4 weeks for secondary, depending on length of service. </li> <li>A home workstation budget of £500 on joining (and £150 per year after that), so your home office serves you well.</li> <li>A personal learning and development budget of £1000 a year, plus 5% L&D time during working hours to build your skills.</li> <li>Private healthcare with BUPA.</li> <li>A medical cash plan covering a range of medical and dental costs.</li> <li>Mental wellbeing coaching and counselling from Self Space.</li> <li>A monthly wellbeing budget via Juno.</li> <li>Life assurance and income protection.</li> <li>Access to Tech and Cycle to Work schemes.</li> <li>A weekly snack allowance for our end-of-week "Need to Know" meeting.</li> <li>A fully-paid one-month sabbatical after five years with Ably.</li> </ul></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Data Scientist - Credit Risk Modelling
description: Senior Data Scientist - Credit Risk Modelling Hybrid in London or remote in the UK We’re looking for a Senior Data Scientist to join our Credit Risk Modelling team. You'll shape how iwoca models credit risk – setting the technical direction on multi-quarter projects, and lifting the bar for the team as you go. The company Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are. That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed. We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive. The team The Credit Risk Modelling team owns credit risk and Customer Lifetime Value (CLtV) modelling for iwoca's UK and German lending. That covers the probabilistic machine learning models behind every credit decision, plus the CLtV models that shape pricing and portfolio strategy. The team is around twelve data scientists. Some work on auto-space models that decide within five minutes from data candidates authorise us to pull. Others work on manual-space models that pick up when a credit analyst adds digital footprint and income data, which lands a decision within 24 hours. The role You'll own credit and CLtV modelling projects end to end, from spotting where the modelling stack is holding the business back through to landing the change. The work spans keeping production models healthy, incremental development, and research that reshapes how the models work. AI has lowered the cost of prototyping enough that ideas which used to sit below the priority line are now viable, so the R&D share of the role is growing. Live examples of the work: Causal estimation of offer terms. Modelling how amount, duration, and price shape customer outcomes. Unifying auto and manual models. The two families were built without forced technical alignment. Finding a principled way to unify them on a common cost function is open work. IFRS accounting model. A multi-stage credit model where information propagates back from later-stage recovery predictions to sharpen upfront loss estimates. Generalising credit and CLtV. Whether a more general framing could replace both separate models is an open research question. The requirements Essential: Communication. You write and speak clearly, directly, and concisely. You adapt technical detail to your audience. Statistical foundations. You have a background in probability and statistics from a quantitative field. You reason about uncertainty and calibration as first-order concerns. Production ML. You have built and shipped supervised ML models end to end – exploration, training, deployment, monitoring. Research mindset. You proactively explore new ways to add value. R&D time is when you expect to find the next step change. Judgement. You critically evaluate model output – yours, a colleague's, or an LLM's – and can explain why a choice is right. You defend your reasoning under challenge, and challenge others' when the evidence points elsewhere. You've influenced technical direction beyond your own projects. Project leadership. You've owned modelling projects end to end, from spotting the opportunity through framing, method choice, shipping, and landing the commercial impact. You move fast, iterate, and update on new evidence rather than chase perfection. AI fluency. You use AI as a primary tool. You prototype with it, automate with it, and take on R&D that would not otherwise be viable. You use judgement on where it helps and where it doesn't. Bonus: Domain experience. You have worked in credit risk, lending, or customer lifetime value modelling. Non-linear methods. You have shipped gradient boosting or neural networks on tabular data in production. Bayesian methods. You have used hierarchical models, MCMC, or Bayesian updating in real work. Time series modelling. You have modelled temporal data where autocorrelation, drift, or seasonality mattered. Python. The stack the team uses. The salary We expect to pay from £90,000 – £120,000 for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews. The culture At iwoca, the best idea wins. We model our culture on independent thinking, challenging untested logic, and evidence-based decisions. We prioritise learning and growth, and give people the autonomy to develop in the direction that makes them most effective. We're a tech company and believe in the power of AI to help us work faster and better. We provide the infrastructure where every iwocan always has access to the best models and where those models have access to all of our data. We will help our people to learn how to use and grow with the new tools available to them. The offices We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work: Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks. Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions. The benefits Flexible working hours. Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership. A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents. 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave. A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years. Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support. 3% Pension contributions on total earnings. An employee equity incentive scheme. Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money. Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme. Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield. And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer: A learning and development budget for everyone. Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers. Access to learning platforms like Treehouse. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you. At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started. Role Overview Harvey is looking for a Compensation Business Partner to ensure our compensation philosophy, principles, and practices extend to all of our markets outside of the US, initially focused on EMEA and APAC. This will be our first Compensation Business Partner dedicated to our international business sitting within the EMEA region, and an opportunity to help shape how Harvey approaches compensation as we continue to scale globally. You’ll partner closely with our People Business Partners, Recruiting team, business leaders, and the broader Compensation team to ensure our programs remain competitive, thoughtful, and scalable across markets. We’re looking for someone who combines deep compensation expertise with strong business judgment. You should be equally comfortable analyzing market data, advising a recruiter on a complex offer, partnering with a PBP and developing a point of view on how Harvey should approach compensation in a new or rapidly evolving market. This is a highly collaborative role that will have a great degree of partnership across many functions. What You'll Do Serve as the primary Compensation Business Partner for EMEA and APAC, developing deep context on our teams, talent markets, and hiring needs across the regions. Partner closely with People Business Partners and business leaders on compensation decisions including new hires, promotions, internal mobility, and other complex compensation questions. Build a particularly strong partnership with Recruiting, advising on offers, market competitiveness, and candidate-specific situations. Help evolve Harvey's international compensation strategy as we scale, including our approach to geographic differentiation, market positioning, salary structures, and equity. Bring deep equity expertise and help translate Harvey's equity philosophy across markets where candidate expectations and familiarity with US-style equity compensation can vary significantly. Research emerging compensation practices and talent trends, particularly across the rapidly evolving AI market, and turn external data into clear recommendations for Harvey. Conduct market analyses using compensation survey data and other sources, while applying judgment. Partner with the broader Compensation team on compensation cycles, benchmarking, band development, and company-wide programs, ensuring international considerations are represented from the beginning. Identify where our US practices translate internationally—and where they don't—and proactively recommend changes as Harvey enters and scales in new markets. Help build the infrastructure, principles, and enablement that will allow Harvey's international compensation approach to scale. What You Have 5-7+ years of experience in compensation Experience supporting international compensation across EMEA and/or APAC. Experience working for a US-headquartered company, with a strong understanding of how global compensation programs are designed and adapted for international markets. Meaningful experience with equity compensation, including the ability to explain and advise on equity in markets with different norms and expectations. Experience in a high-growth startup or scale-up environment; you are comfortable building while the company and market are changing around you. Strong knowledge of compensation fundamentals including market benchmarking, salary structures, job leveling, offers, promotions, retention, and pay decisions. Exceptional business partnership skills. You can build trust with leaders, PBPs, and recruiters while being willing to challenge assumptions. Strong analytical skills paired with excellent judgment—you know when the data is telling you something and when it requires additional context. Intellectual curiosity and a genuine appetite to become an expert on the AI talent market, including proactively researching competitors, compensation trends, and emerging practices. Comfortable operating with ambiguity and building new approaches rather than relying on an established playbook. Ability to communicate complicated compensation concepts simply and credibly to audiences with very different levels of compensation expertise. Not just the big occasions. It’s being there for the highs. Stepping up for the lows. We care wildly about people and our planet. Which is why we’re so proud to be a certified B Corp™ – committed to making long-term positive change for our community, and the world around us. Founded in 2013, our mission back then was to make sending and receiving flowers the joy that it should be, by harnessing technology, brand and letterbox delivery. We announced £75 million Series D funding in 2021 and that same year acquired bloomon in The Netherlands and Bergamotte in France. Together, we’ve fulfilled and delivered over 20 million orders (and counting!), making us the largest direct to consumer flower business in Europe. Now home to a family of 3 beautiful brands, we’re driven by our vision to create the destination for making life a little more thoughtful and beautiful. And we won't stop at flowers and plants. Starting with the Bloom & Wild brand, we're expanding our gifting offering to other categories like cakes, candles and cocktails. This is all part of our ambition to build Europe's #1 direct to consumer gifting destination. 🛠️ The Digital Marketing Team @ Bloom & Wild Group The digital marketing team is responsible for driving sustainable growth in all of the markets we operate in through the execution of innovative, creative and measurable campaigns. You’ll work on paid search campaigns targeting both new and existing customers, working across both our acquisition and retention teams to drive growth across multiple markets, brands and categories. The wider team works collaboratively with internal stakeholders including brand, international, data, and product, while directly managing our external search agency to surface crucial insights and maximize campaign performance. ⚙️ What you'll be doing: Own paid search strategy: lead paid search strategy, developing and executing campaigns across UK, DE, NL and other markets, ensuring alignment with wider marketing, brand and business goals – in particular, supporting Bloom & Wild Group's positioning as a gifting brand, not just selling flowers but also hampers, home, food & drink and more. Own the budget: manage our search budget end-to-end, tracking CAC, LTV and retention costs (RC) to guide investment decisions. Lead our agency partner : Oversee and manage third-party agency partner to execute high-performing campaigns and maximize ROI. Hold the agency accountable to performance targets, strict SLAs, and industry best practices, ensuring they continuously push the boundaries of modern search strategy by adopting cutting-edge tactics, beta programs, and new platform features. Set the optimisation approach: set the keyword strategy, ad copy testing and audience-targeting approach that agency partners and stakeholders execute against, driving Quality Score, CTR and conversion efficiency. Own App Campaigns: oversee Google App Campaigns and Apple Search Ads to drive installs and engagement, aligned to our retention and LTV goals. Manage the Google relationship: work with our Google account manager to unlock alpha/beta opportunities, escalate issues and secure strategic support, along with our agency. Own feed & process: own and continuously improve product feeds and backend processes for Google Shopping and Performance Max (PMax) campaigns. Shape the roadmap: turn channel performance and data into clear, actionable insights that shape the wider paid media roadmap and forecasting, using Tableau and in-platform reporting. Stay ahead of the platform: stay up to date with best practices and market insights, particularly with Google, to prepare for upcoming changes, test new features and champion the latest innovations. Champion AI in search: maintain deep, practical knowledge of modern AI within search engine marketing – platform-level generative AI features, algorithmic updates and LLM-driven search behaviours – and share what you learn with the wider marketing team. Be the go-to expert: act as the go-to person for paid search across the marketing team – mentoring junior colleagues, sharing learnings (e.g. through Lunch & Learns) and giving constructive feedback on paid search work outside your direct remit. Protect share of voice: proactively monitor the competitor landscape, ensuring market share of voice, especially through peak trading moments. ✅ You’ll love this role if you… Are an expert in Google Paid Search: You have extensive, hands-on experience managing Google Search, Shopping, and Performance Max campaigns at scale (experience with Microsoft Advertising or App Campaigns is a bonus). Are fluent in tracking and analytics: You are comfortable working with analytics tools, conversion tracking, and Google Merchant Center, and feel confident navigating privacy- and consent-driven changes to measurement. Love data and reporting: You are a data-driven decision-maker who thrives on deriving insights. You are comfortable using both in-platform tools and Tableau to analyze performance across our custom-built, proprietary e-commerce stack (non-Shopify). Have agency management experience: You have a proven track record of managing third-party agencies to drive results and maintain strategic alignment. Are proactive and hands-on: You take full responsibility and initiative to get things done, with a willingness to roll up your sleeves and get stuck in. Are structured and organized: You take a thoughtful approach to planning, organization, and prioritizing your work to deliver on key business goals. Are curious and adaptable: You love figuring out new tech, testing, learning, and trying new things, often taking the initiative to optimize and improve existing processes. These are some of the skills and experience we think will enable success in this role, but please don’t worry if you are missing some of these. We’re committed to building a team made up of different strengths, skills and experiences, so if you’re excited about our values, passionate about what you do and would like to join us in doing things more thoughtfully, we’d love to hear from you. 🏡 Belonging @ Bloom & Wild We know that we learn through our differences, and building a diverse team has always been central to creating the best experience for our customers. We value all backgrounds, perspectives, ideas and experiences, and encourage everyone to share their opinions openly within our caring and inclusive team. Our champions community actively advances our culture of inclusion and belonging, which is organised around 8 pillars of diversity. These cross-business networks offer additional opportunities for connection, education, support and celebration, and ensure that inclusivity continues to be embedded in our ways of working. 🧭 Our ways of working We really believe in the power of connection. For us that looks different depending on the team you work in. Some of our teams work together in person every day, whereas others may connect in person every quarter. We also believe in flexibility that supports you, the work you do, and your team. How much you work from home and from our office depends on a balance of those needs, and you’ll agree this with your manager. Whether it’s through a shared project, a learning and development opportunity, or an afterwork social - we trust our teams to make the right decisions (for them and us) about where and how they work each day. We’re big on collaboration, empathy, knowledge sharing and growth, and our values drive our priorities every day: Lead change for good: we have the guts to try new things and step up to do what matters most Think deeply, act swiftly : we make sure there’s thoughtful rationale behind our approach and always act swiftly to implement ideas Care wildly: we pour care and creativity into everything we do and pay attention to the things that make a difference Stay open, be curious: we’re open about what we’re doing and why, and we welcome challenges from each other 🌟 Work that works for you To care wildly for our customers, firstly we care wildly for our teams. We work hard to craft a culture of thoughtfulness and care, where there is a strong sense of inclusion and belonging, enabling all of our people to thrive and be successful each day. Our perks and benefits include: ⏰ Flexible working & work from abroad 🌴 25 days holiday + your birthday + flexible bank holidays, & option to buy additional holiday each year 💛 1 Volunteering day each year 🐣 Enhanced family leave and a workplace nursery scheme 🌱 A flexible training framework for every stage of your career 💐 Irresistible discounts on our products, blooms & subscriptions! 📈 Share in our success with a choice to take equity options from day 1 🏋 ClassPass membership: monthly credits to spend on fitness classes, yoga and much more! For more information on our perks & bens, please see www.bloomandwild.com/careers 🫱‍🫲 Getting hired We know that job searching can be daunting, and we want to do everything we can to ensure that your experience with us is a good one. Interviewing is a 2-way process, and we’re keen to answer all of the questions you have, so that you can be sure (and excited!) that we’re the right move for you. We believe in leading change for good, so if there’s anything that we can do to help you flourish throughout your application process with us, or if you have any feedback, please share this with us anonymously here so we can use this to improve your experience. #Bloom&Wild Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

Reporting directly to the Head of Claims UK, you’ll take on two critical responsibilities: Lead our specialist claims operations: Build and lead our Bodily Injury, Third-Party Property Damage, Credit Hire and Engineering teams, taking ownership of their operational performance, claims outcomes and indemnity spend Drive technical excellence across UK Claims: Establish and maintain technical standards across the entire Claims function, ensuring consistent approaches to reserving, liability assessment, claims handling, settlement strategies and quality assurance. This is a rare opportunity to combine direct operational leadership with broader technical authority , shaping not only how we manage our most complex claims but also how our entire Claims organisation operates.We are looking for a visionary leader with an established track record of business-building. You will not just build a team; you will work to define our Technical & Complex Claims philosophy and approach, drive portfolio-level financial performance, and work closely with our Product and Engineering teams to translate your technical expertise into better processes and technology, challenging traditional approaches to claims management. Support the development of technical expertise across the entire Claims organisation through coaching, training, case reviews and knowledge sharing. Work with the Head of Claims UK to identify systemic drivers of claims performance and implement improvements across the function. Ensure technical standards evolve as our portfolio grows, incorporating emerging claims trends, regulatory developments and market best practices. Hold joint accountability (with the Head of Claims UK) for financial performance of the UK Claims portfolio across all teams; Deliver Tech-enabling Domain Expertise : Serve as the lead Subject Matter Expert to Product and Engineering colleagues as we build a market-leading proprietary Claims Management Platform. Support in translating expertise and experience / Technical Claims logic into easy-to-understand business requirements and user needs. Work closely with our Claims Business Architect to design and embed well-structured and effective Technical Claims processes. Collaborate closely with Data Science teams to develop and deploy predictive analytics and automated fraud detection models. What we’re looking for Senior Leadership: 10+ years of senior leadership experience within the UK Retail Motor Insurance market, either at a large UK insurer, MGA, or InsurTech. Transformation Experience: Demonstrated experience of leading major claims transformation activity, with a proven track record of designing, scaling and/or restructuring Complex Claims functions. Financial Acumen: Deep expertise in managing multi-million pound Complex Claims portfolios; proven ability to set reserving philosophies, establish appropriate authority limits, and manage the financial levers that drive Loss Ratio performance. Subject Matter Expertise: Advanced knowledge of all areas of Complex Claims, including Large Loss, Complex Bodily Injury, Credit Hire indemnity strategy, Case Law, Litigation Management. Entrepreneurial Approach: Demonstrably “can-do” mindset; able to effectively operate within a fast-paced MGA environment. Tech-forward Mindset: Strong strategic grasp of how advanced technology (including AI, Machine Learning, and Advanced Data Science) can be used to disrupt and reinvent traditional claims handling processes for the better. People Leadership / Gravitas: Proven ability to lead and inspire a team of ambitious Domain Managers, and Technical Claims Specialists. Purpose of the role Join us to build a world‑class data and analytics platform that will reshape automotive retail. You’ll lead the engineering discipline that powers our data lake, warehouse, real‑time clickstream, and applied AI—turning large‑scale data into trusted, high‑impact products our customers use every day What you’ll lead: Data Platform Engineering Team – Own our AWS‑based datalake, warehouse and core data infrastructure, including security, reliability, cost efficiency and scalability. Analytics Engineering Team – Drive data modelling, transformation and pipeline standards through the lake/warehouse to power governed, reusable semantic layers and metrics. Clickstream Team – Operate and evolve our real‑time event ingestion and processing to bring product telemetry and digital signals into the platform. Key outcomes & responsibilities: Run the function day‑to‑day. Plan, prioritise and deliver across the teams and ensure resilient operations Set platform direction. Support Data Architects and contribute to the modern data architecture on AWS across storage, compute, streaming, governance and cataloguing; align designs to the AWS Well‑Architected Framework and the Data Analytics Lens. Raise engineering standards through Embed IaC, CI/CD for data, AI based development practices, MLOps, testing, observability, lineage and cost/FinOps; codify patterns for batch, streaming and ML. Deliver trustworthy data. Support the teams to establish modelling conventions (e.g., layer boundaries, naming, contracts), data quality SLAs, and a governed metrics layer consumable by our ThoughtSpot visualisation platform. Security, privacy & compliance . Champion least‑privilege access, encryption, auditability and privacy‑by‑design across all datasets. People & performance . Lead managers and senior ICs; grow capability through coaching, clear career paths, hiring, and a high‑performance, inclusive culture. Stakeholder leadership . Partner with Product, Platform, External 3rd Parties and Customer teams to convert business goals into a data roadmap, measurable outcomes and transparent delivery. What you’ll bring: Proven leadership of multi‑team data engineering organisations (platform, analytics engineering, streaming and ML/AI) in a product‑led, cloud‑native environment. Data Architecture and operational expertise with AWS analytics services and modern data architecture (lake + warehouse + streaming under unified governance). Strong track record shipping reliable, cost‑efficient pipelines at scale; credibility in SQL/Python and with at least one of dbt/Spark. Proven experience using AI development tools to increase engineering efficiency MLOps experience: feature pipelines, automated testing, model versioning/registry, promotion workflows and post‑production monitoring. Excellent people leadership: hiring, developing and performance‑managing senior engineers; setting clear goals and creating psychological safety. Effective stakeholder management and communication—from architecture decisions to executive updates. Nice to have: experience with ThoughtSpot, automotive or adjacent domains. Why join us? Join Keyloop and progress your career, your way. An inclusive environment to thrive We’re committed to fostering an inclusive work environment. One that respects all dimensions of diversity. title: Senior Associate - Materials
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Company Description:</strong> Systemiq is a system-change company committed to achieving the Sustainable Development Goals and the Paris Agreement by transforming markets and business models across five key systems: nature and food, materials and circularity, energy, urban areas, and sustainable finance.</p> <p>As a certified B Corp, we combine strategic advisory with high-impact, on-the-ground work, partnering with business, finance, policymakers and civil society to deliver system change. With offices across Africa, Asia, Europe and the Americas, we are dedicated exclusively to sustainability-focused work.</p> <p></p> <p> </p></div><p></p> <h2>Strategy Associate, Materials & Circular Economy</h2> <p><strong>Location: London preferred. Amsterdam also possible</strong></p> <p>Systemiq is looking for a Strategy Associate to join our Materials & Circular Economy team. This role is suited to someone who combines strong strategic thinking with the intellectual curiosity to tackle complex sustainability challenges.</p> <p>You will work on some of the most important questions facing companies, governments and wider society as they shift towards more circular and sustainable models. Projects can range from shaping corporate strategy and identifying new business opportunities to assessing value chains, developing policy recommendations and designing system-level interventions.</p> <p>We are looking for someone who can bring the core toolkit and pace of a strong strategy consultant: structured problem-solving, analytical rigour, clear communication and sound judgement. Strategy consulting experience is one route to demonstrating this. We are equally interested in candidates from other demanding analytical environments who can show the same quality of thinking and ability to turn complexity into clear recommendations.</p> <p>You will join small, senior-led project teams and take meaningful responsibility from the outset. You will structure problems, conduct analysis, develop insights and work directly with clients to translate those insights into practical strategic choices.</p> <h3>Responsibilities</h3> <p>You will:</p> <ul> <li> <p><strong>Structure complex problems:</strong> break ambiguous questions into clear workstreams, hypotheses and analytical priorities.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Generate insights:</strong> conduct rigorous qualitative and quantitative analysis, drawing conclusions from incomplete or complex information.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Shape recommendations:</strong> translate analysis into clear, concise and practical strategic recommendations.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Develop client materials:</strong> produce high-quality presentations, briefings and other client-ready outputs.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Engage with clients:</strong> work directly with senior stakeholders across businesses, governments, foundations and non-governmental organisations.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Contribute to project direction:</strong> help shape project approaches, hypotheses and emerging strategic conclusions.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Build trusted relationships:</strong> work effectively with clients, partners and stakeholders across multi-organisation initiatives.</p> </li> </ul> <h3>About the team</h3> <p>You will be part of Systemiq's Materials & Circular Economy platform, led by Partner Ben Dixon.</p> <p>Ben works across circular economy and energy topics and has advised organisations including the Ellen MacArthur Foundation, the United Nations International Resource Panel and multinational companies across packaging, chemicals and related sectors. He also leads Systemiq's work on plastics, focused on accelerating the transition towards a more circular and resource-efficient plastics system.</p> <h3>What we are looking for</h3> <h4>Strategy and analytical capability</h4> <p>We are looking for candidates who already demonstrate, or can quickly operate with, the core toolkit expected in strategy consulting. You should be able to:</p> <ul> <li> <p>Structure complex and ambiguous problems into clear components, hypotheses and analytical questions.</p> </li> <li> <p>Apply strong analytical judgement to qualitative and quantitative information.</p> </li> <li> <p>Synthesize complex material into concise insights and decision-relevant recommendations.</p> </li> <li> <p>Communicate clearly in writing and verbally, including through high-quality presentation materials.</p> </li> <li> <p>Work effectively at pace, managing changing priorities and imperfect information.</p> </li> <li> <p>Move comfortably between detailed analysis and the broader strategic question.</p> </li> </ul> <h4>Experience and background</h4> <p>You will typically bring:</p> <ul> <li> <p>At least two years of experience in strategy consulting, advisory or another analytically demanding environment.</p> </li> <li> <p>Evidence of strong performance and increasing responsibility in your previous roles.</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience contributing to strategy, investment, commercial or other decision-focused work.</p> </li> <li> <p>Strong academic achievement, typically including a Master's degree or equivalent experience.</p> </li> </ul> <p>We particularly welcome candidates from strategy consulting, but relevant experience could also come from corporate strategy, investing, high-growth businesses, specialist advisory firms or other project-based environments where structured thinking and analytical rigour are central to the role.</p> <h4>Sector interest and understanding</h4> <p>You do not need to be a specialist across every part of the Materials & Circular Economy agenda. You should, however, bring:</p> <ul> <li> <p>An understanding of, or demonstrated ability to learn, complex industrial and consumer value chains.</p> </li> <li> <p>Exposure to sectors such as plastics, petrochemicals, chemicals, consumer goods, manufacturing, mobility, energy or waste management.</p> </li> <li> <p>A strong interest in sustainability, circular economy and the economic and strategic questions involved in system change.</p> </li> </ul> <h3>Location</h3> <p>London is the preferred location for this role. We would also consider Amsterdam for candidates whose experience and capabilities are an especially strong match for the position.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><div id="description__body"></div> <p><strong data-start="578" data-end="603">Diversity & Inclusion</strong><br data-start="603" data-end="606">At Systemiq, we absolutely believe diverse perspectives are essential to driving system change. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where people feel respected, supported and able to do their best work.</p> <p>Click <a href="https://www.systemiq.earth/privacy-policy/">here</a> to view our Data Policy.</p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Software Engineer - Triton
description: <h3 class="PDq2pG_selectionAnchorContainer" data-start="135" data-end="148">About the job</h3> <p data-start="150" data-end="229">Build the framework support that helps AI developers unlock Graphcore hardware.</p> <p data-start="231" data-end="458">You will help Graphcore accelerators work seamlessly with state-of-the-art ML frameworks, including Triton and PyTorch. Reporting to a Team Lead in Frameworks, you will design, implement, optimise and support critical software.</p> <p data-start="460" data-end="660">Your work will shape how researchers and engineers use Graphcore hardware for demanding machine learning workloads. You will improve performance, quality and usability across a complex software stack.</p> <p data-start="662" data-end="874">You will join our Triton team, delivering new features, reviewing code, writing technical documentation and working with upstream communities. You will also help coordinate open-ended technical work across teams.</p> <p data-start="876" data-end="1046">This role offers deep technical ownership and visible impact as the ML software landscape evolves. You will keep learning and may contribute across other framework teams.</p> <h3 data-start="1048" data-end="1068">The team and culture</h3> <p data-start="1070" data-end="1261">The Frameworks team connects Graphcore hardware with the tools ML engineers and researchers rely on. We work across PyTorch, Triton, JAX and TensorFlow, focusing on usability and performance.</p> <p data-start="1263" data-end="1436">Work happens through agile practices, close technical discussion and clear ownership. Engineers are trusted to speak up, solve hard problems and move work forward with pace.</p> <p data-start="1438" data-end="1613">Decisions are shaped by evidence, code quality and business outcomes. You will work across Graphcore and with open-source communities to deliver software developers can trust.</p> <h3 data-start="1615" data-end="1637">What we’re looking for</h3> <p data-start="1639" data-end="2099">· Strong software engineering skills, with the judgement to manage quality, complexity and technical debt.<br>· Experience developing in Python and C++.<br>· Experience in compiler development.<br>· Ability to manage complex technical tasks with cross-team dependencies.<br>· Clear communication skills, with a proactive approach to collaboration and technical leadership.<br>· Interest in AI, ML frameworks, performance optimisation or computationally intensive engineering.</p> <h3 data-start="2315" data-end="2323">Benefits</h3> <p data-start="2325" data-end="3113">· Flexible working: Balance your work and personal life with greater flexibility<br>· Generous leave: Take time to rest, recharge and enjoy life outside of work<br>· Retirement planning support: Up to 5% matched pension<br>· Phantom equity: Share in Graphcore’s success<br>· Workplace experience: Enjoy thoughtfully designed office spaces for collaboration, with free food and an on-site barista to support your day<br>· Peace of mind protection: Income protection and life assurance to provide financial security for you and your loved ones<br>· Flexible benefits: Tailor your benefits package with a choice of additional options, including private medical insurance and dental cover<br>· Optional benefits: Dental cover, health cash plan, private medical insurance, cycle to work scheme, give as you earn</p> <p data-start="3115" data-end="3477">We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences and are committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.<br>We’re an equal opportunity employer and recognise that everyone brings different strengths and perspectives. If you need any adjustments during the interview process, just let us know - we’re happy to support you.</p> <h3 data-start="3650" data-end="3676">Join the Team at Graphcore</h3> <p data-start="3678" data-end="3957">Graphcore is one of the world’s leading innovators in Artificial Intelligence compute. It is developing hardware, software and systems infrastructure that will unlock the next generation of AI breakthroughs and power the widespread adoption of AI solutions across every industry.</p> <p data-start="3959" data-end="4241">As part of the SoftBank Group, Graphcore is a member of an elite family of companies responsible for some of the world’s most transformative technologies. Together, they share a bold vision: to enable Artificial Super Intelligence and ensure its benefits are accessible to everyone.</p> <p data-start="4243" data-end="4565">Graphcore’s teams are drawn from diverse backgrounds and bring a broad range of skills and perspectives. A melting pot of AI research specialists, silicon designers, software engineers and systems architects, Graphcore brings together deep expertise to solve complex problems and deliver meaningful progress in AI compute.</p> <p data-start="4567" data-end="4710" data-is-last-node="" data-is-only-node="">If you want to shape the frameworks developers use to push AI compute forward, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now to be part of the journey.</p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Software Engineer
description: <h3><strong>Senior Engineer</strong></h3> <p>Location: Bristol, London or Edinburgh (hybrid, three days a week in the office)</p> <p>Level: Senior Engineer II (TL1)</p> <p>Team: Engineering</p> <p>Contract: Permanent</p> <p>Reporting To: Software Engineering Manager</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>About Kaluza</strong></p> <p>Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.</p> <p> </p> <p>Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.</p> <p> </p> <p>With teams across Europe, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>What you’ll do</strong></p> <p>You’ll join a technology community of product-focused and data-led product and platform engineers working at scale. We have a diverse ecosystem, spanning TypeScript on AWS, Go on GCP and Scala, we index on product-minded problem solving over language purity.</p> <p>As a Senior Engineer you’ll own a slice of the product end-to-end, from design through to production, and you’ll build AI coding agents as your default. We’re looking for someone whose judgement is worth more than their typing speed.</p> <p>From your first day you’ll have paid access to Claude Code, with a budget we don’t ration, and access to the systems you need through MCP. Our tools and conventions evolve quickly, and you’ll directly impact how we build from here.</p> <p> </p> <ul> <li><strong>Own a slice of the product end to end: </strong>shape the problem with product and design, build the interface and the services behind it, ship it, and run it in production.</li> <li><strong>Work across the stack over time</strong>: depending on the team you’ll work across the interface people use, the services behind it, and the APIs between them, in whatever stack your team runs.</li> <li><strong>Build with AI coding agents as your default</strong>: Break work down so agents can execute, direct them, and review their output as carefully as you’d review a colleague’s pull request. You’ll also maintain the tests and safeguards that let agent written code merge safely.</li> <li><strong>Stay close to the people who use what you build: </strong>directly or through our forward-deployed engineers: a supplier’s operations team, a customer plugging in a car at night. Instrument what you ship so you can see how it’s used, and turn what you learn into shipped changes.</li> <li><strong>Make good work the default: </strong>shape the codebase, conventions and automated checks so that agents and new teammates produce the right thing without anyone catching it in review.</li> <li><strong>Mentor the team around you:</strong> Coach and mentor your peers and help improve how we work and evolve as a team. </li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></p> <p> </p> <p>These are the practices and behaviours we see most in our top engineers and value deeply, but we don't expect everyone to tick every single box. If you're excited by the role and can see yourself thriving here, we’d love to hear from you.</p> <ul> <li><strong>Experience shipping production software:</strong> You have a depth of experience in either a front-end or back-end of a modern stack, and potentially an openness to stretch across both as you navigate our diverse ecosystem.</li> <li><strong>AI coding tools:</strong> You build with tools like Cursor or Claude Code, can walk us through work you’ve shipped this way and review AI output as rigorously as a colleague’s pull request.</li> <li><strong>Able to navigate a complex, high-stakes domain:</strong> You keep complex energy logic legible across microservices, knowing exactly when to use sync vs async to prevent cascading failures.</li> <li><strong>Cloud and operational ownership:</strong> You're comfortable deploying on major cloud platforms using shared tooling. You fully own your software in production, which includes participating in an out-of-hours on-call rota.</li> <li><strong>Strong product sense.</strong> You ask the “why” before building, and you can describe a time when user feedback or metrics changed what you shipped.</li> <li><strong>Clear written communication.</strong> You write specs, pull request descriptions and post-mortems with enough clarity and context that either a human teammate or an AI agent can immediately act on them.</li> <li><strong>A multiplier for your team:</strong> You mentor peers and proactively shape how the team works; introducing conventions, checks or shared context that makes everyone else’s output consistently better.</li> </ul> <p><strong>It would be great if you have</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience building tooling around coding agents, such as MCP servers, skills or CI checks</li> <li>Experience in energy, or another real-time or regulated field</li> </ul> <p><strong>Our Values</strong></p> <p>Five values guide how we work at Kaluza:</p> <p> </p> <ul> <li><strong>Play to win:</strong> Collective pride in decarbonising energy at scale.</li> <li><strong>Solve the real problem:</strong> Cutting through complexity to focus on real-world outcomes.</li> <li><strong>Build trust every day:</strong> Consistency, transparency and doing what we say.</li> <li><strong>Own the outcome:</strong> Full accountability, wins and setbacks, without ego.</li> <li><strong>Go further together: </strong>Collaboration, respect and different perspectives.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Our Perks</strong></p> <p> </p> <ul> <li><strong>Time off and family:</strong> 26 days’ holiday, plus 26 weeks’ full pay for new parents with no qualifying service period</li> <li><strong>Health and security:</strong> Private medical insurance with virtual GP, life assurance, pension scheme, free mortgage advice and eye tests</li> <li><strong>Pay and flexibility:</strong> Discretionary bonus, a Flex Fund of 5% of salary to spend on the benefits you want most, retail discounts through Perks at Work</li> <li><strong>Growth and setup:</strong> Personal learning budget, home office budget</li> <li><strong>Climate:</strong> Access to Furthr, our climate action app</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Come as you are</strong></p> <p> </p> <p>We want to meet people from all walks of life. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be, and we recognise talent on merit and potential. If you’re excited about the role but don’t tick every box, we’d still love to hear from you.</p> <p> </p> <p>This role requires an existing right to work in the UK. We can’t offer visa sponsorship, but we review sponsorship role by role, so keep an eye on our careers site for future opportunities.</p> <p> </p> <p>Find out more on our<a href="https://www.kaluza.com/careers/"> careers page</a> and<a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/kaluza/"> LinkedIn</a>. Our Applicant Data Protection Policy is<a href="https://www.kaluza.com/applicant-data-protection-notice/"> here</a>.</p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Talent Acquisition Coordinator
description: Let’s transform banking forever ClearBank is built on the belief that banking infrastructure shouldn’t slow down progress. Quite the opposite. Speed it up and that’s when you unlock potential. When you really start to innovate. That spirit and ‘can-do’ attitude is why our clients – from FinTech's and crypto platforms, to banks and credit unions – choose to use our API to power their banking infrastructure. But it’s our people who are the stars here. They power that innovation, push harder to break boundaries. They make coming to work (or working from home) fun. They’re the ones we trust to catapult our clients to success. Just as they trust us to build a business that’s always striding forward. What you can expect: As our Talent Acquisition Coordinator, you’ll play an important role in creating a seamless and welcoming experience for candidates and keeping our Talent Acquisition operations running smoothly. You’ll coordinate interviews, maintain accurate information in Ashby and support the production of regular Talent Acquisition reporting. You’ll also work with colleagues across Talent to support supplier administration and help organise our monthly induction for new joiners. This role is suited to someone who enjoys bringing structure to a busy environment, cares about getting the details right and wants every interaction with ClearBank to leave a positive impression. Your role includes: Complete the day-to-day administration of Ashby, maintaining accurate and complete candidate, vacancy and recruitment information to support reliable reporting and compliant hiring processes. Coordinate interviews across multiple time zones, managing candidate and interviewer communication and availability to create a timely, organised and professional experience. Welcome and support candidates attending interviews at the ClearBank office, particularly senior candidates, creating a positive and professional first impression. Monitor recruitment activity and data quality in Ashby, identifying missing, inaccurate or outdated information and working with recruiters to resolve issues promptly. Produce accurate weekly Talent Acquisition dashboards and insights, providing clear visibility of recruitment activity and data to the Talent Acquisition Lead. Support wider Talent operations, including supplier onboarding and offboarding for the Head of Talent and the organisation of monthly new-joiner induction with the Talent Development Manager. Identify opportunities to improve Talent Acquisition coordination and administration, suggesting practical ways to make processes simpler, clearer and more effective. What does success in this role look like: Ashby contains accurate, complete and dependable recruitment information that the Talent Acquisition team can confidently use for reporting and decision-making. Candidates experience organised, timely and thoughtful communication throughout interview coordination and when visiting the ClearBank office. Interviews are coordinated effectively across stakeholders and time zones, with scheduling problems identified and resolved promptly. Weekly Talent Acquisition dashboards are produced accurately and consistently, giving the Talent Acquisition Lead clear visibility of recruitment activity. Supplier administration and monthly induction coordination are organised and reliable, with the relevant stakeholders kept informed. What you’ll bring: To excel in this role, you’ll also need: Previous experience in a Talent Acquisition, recruitment coordination or similar role, with hands-on experience supporting interview scheduling, candidate administration and day-to-day recruitment processes. Strong organisational skills, with the ability to coordinate multiple interviews, activities and competing priorities. Excellent attention to detail, particularly when working with recruitment systems, schedules, reports and confidential information. Confidence communicating with candidates and colleagues at different levels of seniority. The ability to use digital systems effectively and learn new technology and processes quickly. A methodical approach to maintaining accurate records and identifying missing or inconsistent information. The ability to take ownership of assigned tasks, follow agreed processes and ask for support when needed. A little bit more about us! ClearBank is Where You Can belong: At ClearBank we think about Diversity, Equity and Inclusion (DE&I) a lot. Not because we think we should. But because we know we should – how else can we build a happy workforce and be successful as a business. We’re committed to making sure our teams reflect society. And we put energy and effort into making this a place where everyone feels at home, where they’re given the trust and encouragement to do their very best work. Here are some of the things we’re most proud of: 42% of our senior management roles are held by women Our enhanced family leave policies Launching our partnership with Code First Girls Increasing awareness of neurodiversity in the workplace through our partnership with the Inclusive Group Our hiring process and what you can expect: Application: a member of our talent acquisition team will review your application against the key requirements for the role and let you know within two weeks whether you’re moving forward to the next stage; Screening: You’ll spend 30-45 minutes speaking to one of our recruiters learning more about the role and ClearBank, and we’ll get it know more about you, your experience and how your skills align with the role (this will be via phone or Teams video call). You can expect to hear back from us within seven days following this meeting (if things are taking longer than expected, we’ll let you know that too); First Interview: You’ll spend one hour with a member of our hiring team focusing on your skills, competencies and your ways of working at the same time we’ll give you time to ask more questions about the role, the team and learn more about the ClearBank culture. This will be via Teams. Second Interview: This will be a competency-based interview with one or more members of our team. Final Stage: You will have a final meeting with the Head of Department. This will be around 45-60 minutes. Offer: Congratulations! Get ready to transform banking forever! Our commitment to you as a candidate: We will always try our best to get back to you within seven days of your interview whether you’ve been successful or not and provide you with feedback. Sometimes things take a little longer, so we may not have a decision to share but we will get it touch to let you know we need a little more time. We’re unable to provide specific individual feedback at the application or screening stage but know that your application was reviewed and considered carefully.
