title: Partner Engagements Manager, Compliance Strategy
description: Company Description We’re Checkout.com . You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day. We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers. Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale. If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact. With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started. About the role The Partner Engagements Manager, Compliance Strategy will lead Checkout’s external-facing compliance strategy across banking, scheme and other strategic partner relationships. You will own the operating model and delivery of compliance-related partner engagements, including annual reviews, periodic due diligence, requests for information, licensing and scheme initiatives, and readiness for product or geographic expansion. You will ensure that Checkout presents a consistent, accurate and well-evidenced view of its compliance framework, while converting external expectations into practical improvements to our roadmap, controls, processes and operating model. The role combines strategic ownership, senior stakeholder management and hands-on delivery. You will lead complex engagements, advise Compliance leadership, build strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders, and develop the partner-engagement capability of the team, including managing and coaching Senior Analyst(s) as the structure is established. What you will do Own the Compliance Strategy partner-engagement portfolio, prioritising work across banking partners, schemes and other strategic external stakeholders. Establish and continuously improve the operating model for partner engagements, including governance, roles and responsibilities, service standards, evidence expectations, response libraries, escalation routes and management information. Lead annual KYC AML partner compliance reviews, partner onboarding or refreshes, complex RFIs and other material external engagements from planning through to closure. Act as a senior Compliance representative in partner meetings, with high level input around Checkout’s compliance framework, risk management approach, policies, controls, governance and improvement plans with clarity and confidence. Provide oversight and challenge to response packs, control narratives, policy summaries, presentations and supporting evidence, ensuring consistency, accuracy and appropriate ownership. Lead compliance support for scheme, product-launch and geographic-expansion initiatives, ensuring external partner obligations and readiness requirements are identified, tracked and addressed. Translate partner feedback, requests and emerging expectations into strategic recommendations, roadmap priorities, control enhancements and process improvements. Build strong working relationships across Compliance, Legal, Risk, Product, Operations, Commercial, Finance, Technology and regional teams to align delivery and resolve dependencies. Maintain clear governance over engagement risks, issues, decisions, action plans and remediation, escalating material matters to the Head of Compliance Strategy and relevant governance forums. Produce concise and decision-useful updates for Compliance leadership, senior management and governance committees, including themes, trends, risks, commitments and delivery status. Partner with relevant second-line teams to ensure external engagement activity is consistent with the Compliance framework, risk appetite, regulatory obligations and the responsibilities of the three lines of defence. Coach, develop and set clear expectations for Senior Analyst(s). Create and implement a high-quality, scalable and collaborative partner-engagement framework. Identify opportunities to use better data, tooling, workflow design and documentation to improve response quality, reduce duplication and increase the resilience of the Compliance operating model. Represent Compliance Strategy in cross-functional strategic initiatives and take on other priorities that support long-term capability maturation. What you will need to be successful Typically 3–5 years of experience in a similar role within compliance, regulatory compliance, risk, audit, legal or a related function in payments, fintech, banking or another regulated financial-services environment. Demonstrable experience leading external partner, banking, scheme, audit, regulatory or due-diligence engagements. Experience translating regulatory or partner expectations into practical requirements, delivery plans, governance and measurable improvements. Experience leading complex, cross-functional workstreams with multiple stakeholders, dependencies and deadlines. Experience coaching or managing people, setting priorities, giving feedback and creating clarity in a fast-moving environment. Strong understanding of the payments ecosystem and the compliance expectations relevant to banking partners, payment schemes and regulated financial institutions. Working knowledge of relevant compliance domains such as AML/CTF, sanctions, KYC/CDD/EDD, licensing, safeguarding, operational resilience, regulatory change or control assurance. Excellent written and verbal communication, including the ability to present complex issues, defend recommendations and influence senior stakeholders. Strong judgement and the confidence to challenge constructively, distinguish material from non-material issues and escalate appropriately. Strong organisational, analytical and project-management skills, with a track record of delivering high-quality outcomes under pressure. ICA, ACAMS or another relevant professional qualification is desirable. How you will work at Checkout Be The Owner: Set direction, create accountability and ensure commitments are delivered. Talk Straight: Give clear, evidence-led advice and communicate difficult messages respectfully and early. One Team: Build alignment across functions and regions, sharing context and bringing people with you. No Room for Approximation: Set a high bar for accuracy, evidence, consistency and regulatory defensibility. Athlete Mindset: Plan rigorously, raise the standard and keep improving the capability of the function. Better Every Day: Turn recurring engagement friction into scalable processes, tools and operating-model improvements. Pace Matters: Balance urgency with thoughtful risk judgement and disciplined execution. Fundamentally Positive: Lead with trust, humility and a practical, solution-oriented approach. What success looks like Partner engagement framework is clearly documented with detailed SLAs and communicated to all relevant stakeholders. Partner engagements are planned, governed and delivered consistently across the portfolio. Checkout is represented externally through clear, accurate, credible and coherent compliance narratives. Material risks, gaps and commitments are visible to the right stakeholders and managed through to resolution. Scheme, product and geographic-expansion initiatives receive timely and practical Compliance Strategy support. Partner feedback is converted into measurable improvements in processes, documentation, monitoring, tooling and capability. The Senior Analyst(s) and wider stakeholder network have clear priorities, effective ways of working and opportunities to grow. Compliance leadership has reliable management information to understand engagement themes, risks, capacity and progress. Additional Information Bring all of you to work We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one. Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands. We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here. It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable. Life at Checkout.com We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection. Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us. title: Europe Strategy & Operations Director
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>About Faire</strong></span></p> <p>Faire is a technology wholesale platform built on the belief that the future is local. Independent retailers around the globe collectively represent a multi-hundred-billion-dollar wholesale market that has historically been fragmented and offline. At Faire, we're using the power of tech, data, and machine learning to connect this thriving community of entrepreneurs across the globe. Picture your favorite boutique in town — we help them discover the best products from around the world to sell in their stores. With the right tools and insights, we believe that we can level the playing field so businesses can grow and local communities can thrive.</p> <p>We’re looking for smart, resourceful and passionate people to join us as we power the shop local movement. If you believe in community, come join ours.</p></div><p class="p1"><strong>About this role</strong></p> <p class="p1">We're looking for a strategic, analytical leader to drive growth and performance across our European and International business. In this role you'll personally own a high-impact portfolio of initiatives, doing the deep analytical work and driving execution yourself, while setting strategic direction and coaching a small team of individual contributors.</p> <p class="p1">You’ll connect the dots across product and go-to-market, using analytics, customer insights, and opportunity sizing to decide where we invest and how we execute. You’ll partner closely with Product, Operations, Revenue, and Data Science, and become a trusted advisor to senior leadership across the business.</p> <p class="p1">This is a player-coach role for someone who wants to shape strategy and also roll up their sleeves to deliver results. This role is based in London.</p> <p class="p1"><strong>What you’ll do</strong></p> <ul class="ul1"> <li class="li1">Drive OKR attainment for the International team, owning strategy and execution for our Europe Top 8 priorities</li> <li class="li1">Lead and develop a team of Strategy & Operations ICs through coaching, prioritization, and vision setting</li> <li class="li1">Personally own key initiatives in Europe: identify opportunities that move company metrics, align cross-functional teams, remove roadblocks, and lead execution end to end</li> <li class="li1">Prioritize GTM and Product initiatives based on impact, strategic importance, and complexity, and partner with Data Science to build and refine the models that support those decisions</li> <li class="li1">Proactively identify opportunities that grow retailer lifetime value (LTV)</li> <li class="li1">Drive forecasting, performance monitoring, and metric decomps, and surface the insights that matter most to leadership</li> <li class="li1">Build effective, scalable operational processes and close operational gaps</li> <li class="li1">Build trusted relationships with key stakeholders across Product, Operations, Revenue, and leadership</li> </ul> <p class="p1"><strong>Qualifications</strong></p> <ul class="ul1"> <li class="li1">8+ years of experience in consulting, finance (investment banking or private equity), or analytical business operations roles</li> <li class="li1">Experience managing and developing people</li> <li class="li1">Some experience partnering with GTM and Product teams</li> <li class="li1">You are an exceptional creative problem solver. You can break down ambiguous problems and structure a path to an answer.</li> <li class="li1">You are analytical and comfortable with data. You have strong analytical thinking and SQL knowledge, or the willingness to learn it quickly.</li> <li class="li1">You have strong product and business intuition. You can place insights in the context of broader business goals.</li> <li class="li1">You are a scrappy, resourceful executor. When something needs to get done, you remove roadblocks and find a way to make it happen.</li> <li class="li1">You are highly collaborative and influence effectively through others</li> <li class="li1">You are a clear, structured communicator, both written and verbal</li> <li class="li1">You have a strong work ethic and an ownership mindset, and you stay calm and perform under pressure and tight deadlines</li> <li class="li1">You embrace the adventure and do whatever it takes to ensure success</li> </ul> <p><strong>Salary Range</strong></p> <p>London: the pay range for this role is £141,000 to £193,500 per year. </p> <p>This role will also be eligible for equity and benefits. Actual base pay will be determined based on permissible factors such as transferable skills, work experience, market demands, and primary work location. The base pay range provided is subject to change and may be modified in the future.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em><span style="font-weight: 400;"><em data-stringify-type="italic">Hybrid Faire employees currently go into the office 3 days per week on Tuesdays, Thursdays, and a third flex day of their choosing (Monday, Wednesday, or Friday).</em> Additionally, hybrid in-office roles will have the flexibility to work remotely up to 4 weeks per year. Specific Workplace and Information Technology positions may require onsite attendance 5 days per week as will be indicated in the job posting. <br></span></em></p> <p><strong>Why you’ll love working at Faire</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Move fast:</strong> You'll own meaningful problems that serve customers around the globe with the agency to move fast and see your results clearly.</li> <li><strong>Equipped to scale:</strong> We invest in what matters, including the latest enterprise AI tools, to help you work smarter and get more out of every day.</li> <li><strong>Best in class:</strong> Our team is full of sharp, kind, and generous colleagues who care about their craft and about helping you grow in yours.</li> <li><strong>Real rewards.</strong> Competitive pay, equity, and comprehensive benefits designed to support your life inside and outside of work.</li> <li><strong>Belonging:</strong> We're intentional about building an environment where every Faire employee has equal access to opportunities, growth, and success.</li> </ul> <p>Faire was founded in 2017 by a team of early product and engineering leads from Square. We’re backed by some of the top investors in retail and tech including: Y Combinator, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Forerunner Ventures, Khosla Ventures, Sequoia Capital, Founders Fund, and DST Global. We have headquarters in San Francisco and Kitchener-Waterloo, and a global employee presence across offices in Toronto, London, and New York. To learn more about Faire and our customers, you can read more on our <a href="https://blog.faire.com/">blog</a>.</p> <p></p> <p>Faire provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity or gender expression.</p> <p>Faire is committed to providing access, equal opportunity and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment, its services, programs, and activities. title: Senior Sales Executive (Perform by Marcus Evans)
description: Marcus Evans is a global leader in business intelligence, helping our clients grow by making connections, sharing knowledge, inspiring people, building relationships and creating new opportunities. Since 1983, we have brought decision-makers together through high-level summits, conferences, online platforms and performance programmes, working across all sectors and regions. Our overriding approach is one of collaboration, and our belief that “We’ll be our most successful when we work together.” We recognise excellence and actively develop top performers into future leaders. Our culture promotes teamwork, continuous learning and global career growth. About Perform Perform by Marcus Evans is our performance-improvement consultancy. We don’t sell off-the-shelf training. We start with a diagnosis of what is actually holding a team or an organisation back, prescribe the programme that fixes it, deliver bespoke learning pathways facilitated by vetted trainers/coaches, and then assess what changed. Clients get a written view of the gaps, the fix and the result. Job Summary We are hiring a Senior Sales Executives to sell Perform to senior leaders at large organisations: Heads of HR, L&D, Talent and Transformation, and the business executives who sponsor their programmes. You will own the sale from first conversation to signed contract, working with our Programme Scientist, who builds the diagnosis and prescription behind every proposal. This is a consultative sale with long cycles, several stakeholders and meaningful deal values. We are looking for someone who has done it before and wants to build a book of business from the start. This is an onsite role based in our London office. Key Responsibilities Generate and qualify your own pipeline through targeted outreach, networking, referrals and social selling to senior HR, L&D and business leaders Run structured discovery calls using our Initial Discovery Template, so the client’s real performance problem is clear before any proposal is written Work with the Programme Scientist to turn discovery into a bespoke diagnosis, prescription and quote, and present it to the client sponsor Position Perform as an expert advisor, qualify prospects rigorously, and manage intake so each quarter’s cohorts are full and the programme stays selective Negotiate pricing and terms within our pricing framework, and take contracts through to signature Keep every opportunity current in HubSpot CRM, from contact to lead to deal, so forecasting and reporting are accurate Stay with the client after signature through delivery and assessment, and use the findings to open expansion and renewal conversations Share what you learn from the market (objections, competitors, pricing pressure) with the leadership team so the offer keeps improving Qualifications Required: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Behavioural Science or related fields. At least five years of B2B sales experience, including closing complex, high-value deals with multiple stakeholders Proven experience selling leadership development, learning and development, coaching, talent, HR consulting or other professional services to senior buyers A record of meeting or exceeding targets, with examples you can discuss Excellent written and spoken English, and the credibility to hold a conversation with a C-suite executive Comfort with discovery-led, consultative selling rather than product pitching Right to work in the UK Preferred: Experience selling to financial services, banking, technology or other regulated, multinational clients An existing network among HR and L&D decision-makers Experience working alongside subject-matter experts or consultants to build proposals HubSpot, LinkedIn Sales Navigator or comparable CRM and prospecting tools Additional languages Marcus Evans is an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity, and all employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit and business need. #LI-Onsite Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Product Management Director – Soft FM & Estates (UK)
description: About SINGU At SINGU , we’re redefining how the world’s most ambitious real estate companies run their operations. Our mission is to become Europe’s leading platform for managing warehouse, logistics, retail, and multi-site commercial real estate portfolios — empowering our Clients to protect revenue, boost efficiency, and unlock new value across every aspect of their business. Our unified CAFM platform already powers the daily operations of over 250 million m² of real estate worldwide , supporting more than 500,000 professionals. Following our union with the UK’s Micad and Germany’s net-haus, we now help manage 100,000+ buildings across 35+ countries — and we’re just getting started. Backed by a leading growth equity investor, we’re scaling rapidly and partnering with global leaders such as Prologis, ECE, CTP, Hillwood, Logicor, GLP, and Unibail-Rodamco-Westfield. As we continue to grow through strategic acquisitions and bold innovation, we stay true to our core values: adaptability, collaboration, and client focus. If you’re ready to help build Europe’s leading platform for property operations — and make a tangible impact on how the real estate industry works — join SINGU and be part of this transformation. About the Role You'll own a significant slice of the SINGU product suite: space management and Soft FM services – cleaning standards, portering, and catering – used every day primarily across the UK healthcare market . Product-market fit is established and thousands of users depend on these products daily. What the portfolio needs now is strategic direction and taking them to their next level of growth. You'll do that through a team of four Product Managers who are domain experts in the products they run. This is a hands-on leadership role . You'll stay close to customer problems yourself, you'll raise the bar on how the team discovers and validates work, and you'll have real autonomy to decide what's worth building – and to prove it works. SINGU group grows both organically and through acquisition, and several of these products arrived with the companies that built them. You'll shape the strategy for bringing them into one coherent ecosystem and lead your team through that change. If you enjoy taking a set of good but separate products and making them add up to something bigger, that is the interesting part of this job. You'll partner closely with Sales, Engineering, and Product colleagues across the SINGU Group so your portfolio drives revenue and solves real problems across the European FM market. AI is a must-have lever in our industry rather than a talking point: you'll be applying it where it measurably improves how our customers run their estates. This is a remote position with periodic travel to London and Kraków – roughly every two to four weeks. Role Scope People Leadership & Team Development: Manage and develop the Product Managers within the product team. Own the full management lifecycle: hiring, onboarding, mentorship, feedback, coaching, performance evaluations, promotions, and exits . Foster a high-performing product culture based on customer empathy, data-driven decision-making, and outcome orientation. Manage staffing and focus areas across the suite, reallocating product resources where needed to balance discovery workload and meet strategic priorities. Lead the team through change – new ways of working, a shifting portfolio, and product consolidation – bringing people with you rather than around them. Product Discovery & Strategy: Define and maintain product roadmaps aligned with business objectives, customer needs, and market trends. Decide where to invest and where to hold : set a clear, defensible position on which initiatives scale and communicate it across the business. Build strong alignment with the Sales team to ensure product discovery and roadmap priorities actively unblock deals and support revenue growth. Identify and resolve ambiguities, dependencies, and competing priorities that impact discovery quality and speed. Product Management Best Practices & Standards: Promote modern product practices, including continuous discovery, outcome-based roadmapping, and hypothesis-driven development . Ensure product teams consistently validate assumptions through user research, experimentation, and data analysis . Drive improvements in requirements quality, stakeholder communication, prioritization frameworks, and release planning. Cooperate with the Chief Architect and Engineering Managers to ensure product decisions account for technical feasibility and platform constraints. Drive the adoption of AI-powered tools and analytics to improve product insights, customer understanding, and decision-making quality. Collaboration & Cross-Company Coordination: Coordinate with commercial and customer-facing teams to align product strategy with go-to-market plans and revenue goals for the portfolio. Represent the company at external events, conferences, and industry forums to share product insights, build the Group's profile, and stay connected to market trends. Maintain alignment, knowledge sharing, and team cohesion with colleagues across the Group. Experience & Requirements Must have's: 5+ years in product management , ideally with at least three of them in B2B SaaS . Strong B2C experience in FM, healthcare, or an adjacent domain is also worth a conversation. At least two years leading a team as a people manager – product managers ideally, but we are flexible on the setup; what matters is that you have owned a team, not that you are ready to start. Experience taking a team or a product area through real change: new ways of working, a restructure, or post-acquisition integration – and bringing the sceptics with you. Demonstrable experience applying AI within product development , using AI-powered tooling to accelerate discovery and delivery. Proven track record of leading product discovery across multiple methods and translating insights into validated roadmaps. Strong commercial awareness : able to partner with Sales and align product decisions with revenue and retention goals. Data fluency : comfortable defining metrics, querying product analytics, and using quantitative evidence to drive decisions. Excellent stakeholder communication : able to frame trade-offs and build alignment across technical and non-technical audiences. English at C1 or above , written and spoken, with the confidence to represent the product externally. Nice to Have's: Experience working in empowered product trios (or similar cross-functional squads) with engineering and design. Experience in healthcare (ideally the UK market, NHS) , public sector, or government-adjacent markets. Familiarity with platform or multi-product portfolio environments . Experience integrating acquired products into a single coherent platform. Polish or German alongside English . Not sure you tick every box? If you are strong on product leadership and craft but light on one of the requirements, we would still like to hear from you. Why Here Real ownership: you own a portfolio and the team that runs it. Strategy, discovery, and outcomes are yours, not a backlog handed down to you. Modern product culture: we work in trios, practice continuous discovery, and ship to learn. AI that makes sense: you'll apply AI to a platform customers already rely on, where it measurably improves how they run their estates – not bolted on for its own sake. A stable base for ambitious work: SINGU is profitable and growing , with consistently stable results. Growth: SINGU keeps growing through acquisition, so new areas to consolidate and lead keep appearing. International scope: five companies and around 250 people across Poland, the UK, and Germany, with a portfolio that spans markets rather than one office. If this role sounds like a good fit, we’d love to hear from you. Apply and help us build technology that supports critical operations every day. title: Security Engineer
description: About CuspAI CuspAI is the frontier AI company on a mission to solve the breakthrough materials needed to power human progress. While nature took billions of years to perfect molecules, we are harnessing AI to unlock trillion-dollar materials breakthroughs in months, not millennia. Our founding team is the most cited in the world, comprised of world-class researchers in AI, chemistry and engineering. We are working on some of the hardest and most important challenges including energy, clean water, the future of compute, and carbon capture, and this is just the start of what our 'search engine' for next-generation materials will unlock. We invite you to be part of a diverse, innovative team at the intersection of AI and materials science, working to create impactful partnerships that drive innovation, scalability, and industry collaboration. This work matters. Your work matters. We’re on the cusp of the on-demand materials era. Join us. The Role Due to our rapid growth and the sensitivity of our proprietary materials discovery platform, we are seeking a Security Engineer to ensure our innovation happens at speed without compromising the safety of our IP or our users. Your Impact In this role you will be building the automated security pipelines and AI-specific guardrails that protect our frontier models and research data, which is critical for maintaining the integrity of our materials discovery engine and the trust of our global partners. As an early security hire, you won't be a manual blocker; instead, you will architect a "shift-left" culture where security is a fundamental product feature. Your work ensures that as we scale our search for next-generation materials, our underlying infrastructure and world-class IP remain safely locked down. What You Will Do AI-Specific Security & IP Protection Secure the end-to-end ML lifecycle, implementing defenses against data poisoning and protecting our proprietary model weights from theft. Design and deploy prompt injection defenses and runtime firewalls to prevent unauthorized manipulation of our LLM interfaces. Implement AI Security Posture Management (AI-SPM) to monitor and catalog self-hosted models, internal training datasets, and proprietary endpoints. Cloud Security, CI/CD & Core DevSecOps Weave automated security “guardrails” directly into our CI/CD workflows, including secret scanning, API exposure checks, and software composition analysis (SCA). Codify security policies using Infrastructure as Code (IaC), ensuring all cloud resources are automatically compliant with global standards (e.g. GDPR, SOC2). Manage secrets and vulnerability patching for containerized environments (e.g. Docker, Kubernetes) to ensure our research environment is resilient. Design strict, least-privilege Identity and Access Management (IAM) controls to isolate sensitive training data and research workloads. Interdisciplinary Collaboration & Security Culture Lead incident response efforts by monitoring production logs for anomalies and collaborating with AI Researchers to deploy rapid fixes. Empower the engineering team to own security by providing tools for local IDE security scanning and pre-commit hooks. Act as a security educator, cultivating a culture of shared responsibility across the AI, chemistry, and engineering teams. Partner with researchers, chemists, and engineers to translate security requirements into practical workflows that support rather than slow down scientific work. Must Have Skills and Qualifications: You are motivated by the mission of using AI for planetary-scale impact and understand the high stakes of securing "deep tech" intellectual property. 3+ years of experience in a DevSecOps, Cloud Security, or Site Reliability Engineering role, preferably within a fast-paced startup or AI-centric company. Proven experience building and securing CI/CD pipelines (e.g. GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or Jenkins). Strong proficiency in Infrastructure as Code (e.g. Terraform, Pulumi) and securing cloud environments (AWS, GCP, or Azure). Deep understanding of container security and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes). Practical knowledge of security frameworks and how to implement them without slowing down development cycles. Bonus Points (But Not Critical): Direct experience with AI-specific security tools or defending against LLM-specific vulnerabilities (OWASP Top 10 for LLMs). Experience with AI Security Posture Management (AI-SPM) tools. Relevant certifications such as AWS Certified Security, CSEP, or OSCP. A background or personal interest in materials science, chemistry, or the intersection of AI and physical sciences. Additional Considerations This role could be based in our Cambridge, London, Amsterdam or Berlin offices, with the expectation of being in the office three days per week. Additionally, there may be regular travel required to other locations for collaboration and project work. As part of your onboarding, you will be expected to spend at least a few weeks in our Cambridge/London office learning about our platform and getting to know us in person. Additionally, there may be regular travel required to Europe and other regional and global locations for collaboration and project work. What We Offer A competitive salary: We value and reward impact and growth Equity in CuspAI: You have a stake in the success of the company Time off to stay fresh: 28 days holiday (DE, NL, UK) or 21 days holiday (JP, SG, US), in addition to local public holidays ‘Gold Standard’ parental leave: 26 weeks (primary caregiver) and 12 weeks (secondary caregiver) at full pay - we look after you and your family while we work on the most important materials discovery problems together Professional development budget: We invest in your career development so you can stay up to date with the latest industry knowledge or add to your skills to increase impact and growth Solve meaningful problems: See how your work has a direct impact on advancing materials science and solving sustainability and climate-related problems through the creation and application of bleeding-edge SOTA technology and revolutionary techniques True interdisciplinary teamwork: Be part of a deeply collaborative environment bridging AI research, computational chemistry, and experimental science - work with world-class researchers and engineers who enjoy sharing knowledge and supporting each other Join us in shaping the future of materials with AI. Together, we can create groundbreaking solutions for a more sustainable world. CuspAI is an equal opportunities employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace . We do not discriminate on the basis of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding), veteran status, or any other basis protected by applicable law. We actively encourage applications from all backgrounds and value the unique perspectives and contributions that diversity brings to our team. Please let us know if you require any specific adjustments during or after the interview process. We will do everything we can within reason to accommodate. Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Software Engineer - Platform Integration, Robot Software
description: Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve. We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that. Here’s what this particular role covers. 🛠️ About our Engineering Teams Wayve’s Robot Software group turns new vehicle programs into stable, reliable robot systems. The Platform Integration team works at the boundary between onboard software and vehicle hardware, bringing up new platforms while building reusable components and frameworks that make every future integration faster and more predictable. As a Software Engineer on the Platform Integration team, you’ll combine hands-on vehicle and bench work with production software development. Your work will directly enable safe, scalable deployment across multiple vehicle programs. 🧠 Your day-to-day Support software bring-up on benches, HiL systems, and vehicles, including work at international test locations. Develop and maintain vehicle-facing software components and shared frameworks. Diagnose integration issues across software and hardware boundaries and drive them through resolution. Identify architectural improvements that reduce bespoke work and improve reuse. Build diagnostics, tooling, and metrics for robot-software reliability and performance. Produce clear documentation and runbooks for long-term supportability. Collaborate with hardware, safety, controls, calibration, and reliability teams. 🧩 What you’ll be working on New vehicle-program bring-up across embedded compute, sensors, networks, and software services. Linux-based robotic and automotive systems with multi-process and distributed architectures. ROS2 or similar middleware, node development, message interfaces, and system integration. Sensor calibration, synchronisation, data validation, and system-level debugging. Automotive-grade compute platforms such as NVIDIA DRIVE and Qualcomm Snapdragon Ride. Vehicle communication systems including CAN and Automotive Ethernet. Shared abstractions and frameworks that improve reliability across programs. 🙌 You should apply if You have strong software-development experience in C++, Python, or Rust. You have delivered production-quality software on Linux-based robotic, embedded, or automotive platforms. You understand ROS2 or similar robotics middleware and distributed-system integration. You have hands-on experience integrating software with vehicle or embedded hardware. You can diagnose complex problems using logs, telemetry, on-target tests, and systematic experimentation. You understand vehicle sensors, networking, and the practical realities of platform bring-up. Experience with drive-by-wire systems, CAN tools, shared frameworks, HiL or simulation, functional safety, technical documentation, or observability would be valuable. 🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement. More about Wayve: 🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines. Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility. How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working: Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives. 🔍 The Interview Process: Our process is clear and respectful of your time: Initial recruiter screen — 25 mins Competency Interviews — Programming and technical domain (2 hours) Deep-dive technical interviews — Programming, software design, and hiring-manager/team fit (3 hours) Final interview — Mission and values alignment (30 mins) We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability. What’s in it for you (Location dependant): 💰 Salaries benchmarked against the market annually 📈 Meaningful equity, sharing in the ownership and long term success of Wayve ✈️ Relocation support and visa sponsorship where applicable ✅ Hybrid working, core hours and the chance to work hands on in vehicle workshops and labs 📚 Learning and development budgets with support for training, conferences and growth 🩺 Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, dental, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, retirement or pension where applicable, access to therapists, wellbeing partnerships, team socials and more A quick, honest note before you apply. Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one. If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you. At Wayve we're committed to creating a diverse, fair and respectful culture that is inclusive of everyone based on their unique skills and perspectives, and regardless of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding) or any other basis as protected by applicable law. For more information visit Careers at Wayve. To learn more about what drives us, visit Values at Wayve DISCLAIMER: We will not ask about marriage or pregnancy, care responsibilities or disabilities in any of our job adverts or interviews. However, we do look to capture information about care responsibilities, and disabilities among other diversity information as part of an optional DEI Monitoring form to help us identify areas of improvement in our hiring process and ensure that the process is inclusive and non-discriminatory. title: Technical Product Manager, Developer Experience & Product-Led Growth
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About Telnyx</strong></p> <p><em><span style="font-weight: 400;">Telnyx is an industry leader that's not just imagining the future of global connectivity—we're building it. As a testament to our success, we're proud to stand as a financially stable and profitable company. Our robust profitability allows us not only to invest in pioneering technologies but also to foster an environment of continuous learning and growth for our team.</span></em></p> <p><em><span style="font-weight: 400;">Our collective vision is a world where borderless connectivity fuels limitless innovation. By joining us, you can be part of laying the foundations for this interconnected future. We're currently seeking passionate individuals who are excited about the opportunity to contribute to an industry-shaping company while growing their own skills and careers.</span></em></p></div><p><strong>The Role</strong></p> <p>We're looking for a highly technical Product Manager to own how developers discover, build on and grow with Telnyx.</p> <p>Telnyx operates a global infrastructure platform spanning communications, AI inference, GPUs, edge compute, databases and real-time applications. We've invested heavily in building the underlying infrastructure. Now we want to make it dramatically easier for developers to understand what's possible, build useful applications and get into production.</p> <p>This is a hands-on product role leading a small team of six engineers across Developer Relations and Product-Led Growth. We aren't looking for a traditional DevRel leader or someone whose primary skill is managing people. We want a strong engineer with excellent product judgment who understands developer experience, builds things personally and knows how to turn developer adoption into revenue. </p> <p><strong>The Team</strong></p> <p>You'll lead a team of six: three DevRel engineers (sample apps, open source, technical content and demos) and three PLG engineers (activation, AI agents and automation, self-service conversion and expansion). You'll report to the Chief Operating Officer. </p> <p><strong>What you'll own</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build applications developers actually want to use — Lead the DevRel team in building production-quality sample applications, integrations, templates and reference implementations on Telnyx. Publish them on GitHub, maintain them and make them easy for developers to deploy and extend. Turn those applications into compelling technical content, live demos and developer distribution.</li> <li>Drive product-led growth — Own the PLG operation responsible for moving developers from signup to meaningful usage and revenue. Use product telemetry, behavioral signals, AI agents and human intervention to identify friction, accelerate onboarding, improve conversion and expand self-service usage.</li> <li>Make the developer experience better — Get hands-on with our APIs, SDKs, documentation and infrastructure. Work directly with product engineering to identify and resolve the issues that make products difficult to use. Our reference applications should continuously test whether our products are genuinely ready for developers.</li> <li>Build AI-native growth systems — Work with Growth Engineering and RevOps to develop automated workflows for developer acquisition, onboarding, account intelligence, technical assistance and expansion. We believe small teams of excellent technical people supervising powerful automation can outperform much larger traditional GTM organizations.</li> <li>Connect the entire developer journey — Applications attract developers. Developers experiment with the platform. PLG helps them succeed. Production usage generates revenue. The feedback from that process improves our products and informs what we build next. You'll be accountable for making that system work. .</li> </ul> <p><strong>What we're looking for</strong></p> <ul> <li>A strong software engineering background. You should be comfortable building and debugging real applications, working with APIs, reading code and understanding complex infrastructure.</li> <li>Experience as a Technical Product Manager, founding engineer, technical founder or similar role with substantial personal responsibility for shipping software.</li> <li>Exceptional product judgment, particularly around developer tools, APIs, documentation, onboarding and usability.</li> <li>Familiarity with AI infrastructure, LLMs, inference, cloud platforms, real-time systems or developer infrastructure.</li> <li>Understanding of product-led growth, including developer acquisition, activation, conversion, retention and monetization.</li> <li>Ability to work with AI coding agents, automation frameworks, product analytics and modern developer tooling.</li> <li>Strong technical communication skills. You can explain complicated technologies clearly and recognize what makes a useful demonstration or reference application.</li> <li>Comfortable leading a small technical team while remaining deeply involved in the actual work.</li> </ul> <p>Experience at a developer infrastructure company is valuable. Experience personally building and growing something developers love is more important.</p> <p><strong>How we'll measure success</strong></p> <p><strong>Your primary objective is growing developer-led revenue on Telnyx.</strong></p> <p>We'll look at activated developers, production applications deployed, self-service conversion, usage expansion and retention. We'll also measure the adoption of our reference applications, how effectively our developer content attracts users and how quickly developers can get from signup to a working application.</p> <p>We care about applications developers actually use, not demos shipped for the sake of demos. We care about developers reaching production, not just generating signups. And we care about revenue, not vanity metrics.</p> <p><strong>Who will thrive here</strong></p> <p>Someone who would rather build a working prototype than spend a week debating a roadmap. Someone who notices a broken onboarding experience and immediately starts fixing it. Someone who understands both what makes infrastructure technically excellent and what makes developers want to use it.</p> <p>You should be capable of leading six very technical people because you have the engineering ability, product instincts and judgment to make everyone around you more effective.</p> <p><strong>This is a builder's job, not a professional management job.</strong></p> <p>We're looking for someone who can make Telnyx a platform developers genuinely love building on, and turn that into a meaningful business.</p> <h6><span style="font-weight: 400;">#LI-RH1</span></h6><div class="content-conclusion"><p> </p> <p> </p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: VP of Data
description: About Us Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact. We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem . Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work. At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team. Visit www.perk.com to learn more. Why this role, why now 12,000+ companies trust Perk with their travel and spend, and we've brought both together in one intelligent platform. Every booking, expense and invoice adds to a wealth of data at your fingertips, and now is the moment to enable teams to use this data intelligently to power better decisions, precise reporting, and to create cost and time savings for our customers. Come lead the team that makes all of this possible. The Role Data is at the core of Perk's innovation and the backbone of how we will evolve our products using new technology. As our VP of Data, you'll step into one of the most influential leadership roles in Builders (Data, Product, Design, Engineering) with a direct hand in shaping Perk's strategy and success, and we scale our multi product platform. Reporting to our President of Product and Technology, you'll lead a 40+ person organisation, with a remit that spans our Travel, Spend, and Events products. This role also spans our core functions and drives the business, including Customer Care, Marketing, Finance, Revenue and People. You'll join a strong, talented team with a clear mandate to shape how we create exceptional products at Perk, using our proprietary data. Across travel, spend, and events, Perk holds a wealth of data that touches every booking, expense, invoice and payment. Your opportunity is to reshape it so it powers smarter, more intelligent products that keep us on the cutting edge of what is possible. This is a role for a data leader who thrives in fast-paced environments, scales high-performing organisations through senior leaders, and has the technical credibility to go deep when it matters. You'll join a top-notch leadership team where we elevate each other, build shared strategies and win together. You'll help define how we grow and make decisions, with accountability for data across the whole company. Your team You’ll lead a talented, collaborative and innovative team who are excellent at what they do. They span seven crafts: Data Product Partners, Reporting Analytics, Data Analytics, Analytics Engineering, Data Engineering, Data Science and Data Governance. Together they power the work the business relies on every day, and they’re ready to take data to its next stage of scale with you. Your missions Strategy and Roadmap . More than ever data informs everything we do and is core to the AI native products that we build. You’ll own the long term vision and strategy for data architecture, analytics, predictive modeling, and AI product integration . Work hand in hand with Product, Engineering and Platform teams across Perk to turn machine learning and advanced analytics into products customers love. Set the standard for trust. Own data governance, privacy and compliance, so security and regulatory requirements are built in from the start. Partner with our AI leadership to make sure the data behind every AI product is trusted, so everything we build earns customer confidence. Build a data platform we rely on. Run data infrastructure like a flagship product: governed, reliable, built for scale from day one. You own the budget and the build, buy and prioritisation calls. Lead with conviction. Unify the craft, standards and roadmap across teams so data speaks with one voice, and anticipates questions before they're asked. Be the data voice alongside Product, Engineering, Finance, Customer Care, Marketing, Revenue and People. Grow leaders who grow the business. Coach your senior leaders, shape the operating model and org design, attract top talent, and build a culture of ownership, autonomy and measurable results. What success looks like Data is the foundation of products that know our customers and anticipate what they need: personalised experiences, smarter recommendations and proactive insights, so they get answers before they have to ask. You've built a high-performing, trusted data organisation that delivers measurable value across the business so all functions use and trust the data to shape decisions, inform strategy and change how we work, well beyond reporting. Your teams operate with clear priorities, solid infrastructure and real ownership, and what they ship is core to our business and our success. Lead and influence, partner with executive leaders to shape the questions and drive the decisions that matter most. What you'll bring Proven scale-up leadership. You've led data organisations in high-growth tech or SaaS, and you've built this muscle before. Leader of leaders. You've scaled organisations of 40 or more through senior leaders, coached leaders of leaders and hired top talent. Technical excellence and innovation. A data science background combined with analytics and data engineering, and the depth to push what's possible in any direction. Executive leadership. You've owned a data strategy and budget at executive level, made the big build, buy and invest calls, and helped set company direction alongside senior leadership. Modern stack fluency. Fluency across the modern data stack, such as dbt, Snowflake, conversational analytics and Looker or Tableau, plus the instinct to build your own tooling where it gives us an edge. Trust by design. Deep understanding of data privacy, governance and compliance, including GDPR. Partnership at every level. Proven trusted partnerships across Product, Engineering, Finance and Operations, and the communication skills to influence at the most senior levels and drive alignment. Big picture and fine detail. You move comfortably between company-level strategy and hands-on specifics. AI at Perk AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes. How We Work At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work. For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume. Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you. Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @ perk.com or @ externalperk.com , our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com , and we will confirm whether it is legitimate. #LI-Hybrid Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Content Designer UK
description: <div class="content-intro"><h4><strong>Who We Are</strong></h4> <p>WPP Enterprise Solutions designs, builds, and operates the growth systems that competitive businesses rely on. In a world where Al is reshaping how companies drive growth, we lead clients in business transformation and marketing modernization, connecting strategy directly to execution. Our 12,000 experts in engineering and platforms, commerce, consulting, content transformation, CRM, and CX work within a unified global operating unit across 40+ markets. WPP Enterprise Solutions works alongside best-in-class partners including Adobe, AWS, Braze, Google, Microsoft, Salesforce, and Shopify, as well as innovators in AI, to deliver growth solutions tailored to the needs of our clients’ businesses. VML, part of WPP, supports WPP Enterprise Solutions by helping brands activate transformation through creativity and experience.</p></div><h3> </h3> <h3>Senior Content Designer needed to join our Design Team on a permanent basis.</h3> <p> </p> <h3>The opportunity</h3> <p>We’re looking for a confident, creative and versatile Senior Content Designer to work on our client’s website experience.</p> <p>As a Senior Content Designer, you’ll be shaping experiences that are rewarding, personalised and effortless in every interaction.</p> <p>You’ll find new opportunities and improve existing journeys, crafting intuitive and engaging solutions for major product initiatives, multi-step journeys, campaign activity and vehicle launches.</p> <p>You’ll weigh business objectives with user expectations, delivering content that exceeds both. And you’ll use language to engage, inform, guide and persuade.</p> <p>So, you’ll really need to know the value the right content can add to a customer journey. Plus, you’ll need a big appetite for using customer research, data and analytics and smart uses of AI to guide your design process.</p> <p>You’ll work mostly independently, with support from a Content Lead to provide direction, review your work and help navigate complex decisions.</p> <h3> </h3> <h3>What you’ll be doing</h3> <ul> <li><strong>Own Major Initiatives & Launches: </strong>Drive the end-to-end content design for flagship launches, multi-step customer flows, and complex campaign-driven journeys across digital platforms.</li> <li><strong>Be the Content Advocate in Early Discovery: </strong>Partner early with product managers and UX leads in the concept phase, shaping product intent, defining information hierarchy, and solving UX problems with content before visuals are developed<strong>.</strong></li> <li><strong>Architect Complex Journeys: </strong>Design and structure multi-step content architecture, taxonomy, and navigation paths to ensure seamless transitions across complex digital touchpoints.</li> <li><strong>Evolve the Content Design System: </strong>Define and document reusable content components, patterns, and copy standards within our design system to ensure long-term consistency across digital products.</li> <li><strong>Establish Governance Frameworks: </strong>Define clear content governance models, review processes, and quality frameworks so high standards and brand consistency are maintained post-launch.</li> <li><strong>Drive Data-Informed Decisions</strong>: Interrogate quantitative performance data (conversion, drop-off, engagement) and qualitative research to formulate hypotheses, test copy variations, and make evidence-based design iterations.</li> <li><strong>Foster Cross-Functional Alignment: </strong>Work autonomously with cross-functional partners across Product, Engineering, Brand, Marketing, and Legal to align journey messaging with product requirements.</li> <li><strong>Ensure Accessibility & Inclusivity: </strong>Ensure all multi-step flows and launch content comply with modern accessibility standards (WCAG), plain language requirements, and assistive technology needs.</li> <li><strong>Leverage Modern Tooling: </strong>Work hands-on in tools like Figma and FigJam to document user flows, wireframe content layouts, prototype copy in situ, and explore AI-assisted workflows to optimise efficiency.</li> </ul> <h3> </h3> <h3>What we want from you</h3> <ul> <li><strong>Deep Content Design Experience:</strong> Proven track record designing content for complex digital products, multi-step journeys, or major customer-facing campaign launches.</li> <li><strong>Complex Journey & Architecture Skills:</strong> Demonstrated capability in content architecture, information hierarchy, and structuring complicated user flows into clear, intuitive journeys.</li> <li><strong>Early-Phase UX Advocacy:</strong> Experience collaborating with product and design partners at the problem-framing stage, shaping the solution before high-fidelity design work starts.</li> <li><strong>Design Systems & Governance Experience:</strong> Practical experience developing, documenting, or applying content design system components, style guidelines, and governance processes.</li> <li><strong>Strong Data Literacy:</strong> Comfortable using analytics, conversion metrics, and user research findings to steer content decisions and evaluate performance.</li> <li><strong>Cross-Discipline Alignment:</strong> Skilled at collaborating autonomously with stakeholders across product, marketing, and brand to align on goals and resolve conflicting priorities.</li> <li><strong>Figma & Prototyping:</strong> Hands-on experience working directly inside Figma and modern collaborative tools to prototype content alongside UX/UI designers.</li> <li><strong>Accessibility Expertise:</strong> A thorough working knowledge of digital accessibility, screen-reader compatibility, and inclusive language principles.</li> <li><strong>Relevant Background:</strong> A degree or equivalent hands-on experience in English, Communications, Human-Computer Interaction (HCI), UX Design, or a related field. Proof of user-centred decisions, testing or iteration.</li> </ul> <h3> </h3> <h3>If you know some of this, even better</h3> <ul> <li>Experience working on major product rollouts or campaign launches within automotive, luxury, or high-volume e-commerce.</li> <li>Specialist training or certifications in Information Architecture or Content Strategy.</li> <li>Experience establishing content governance or editorial review workflows across large, multi-brand platforms.</li> </ul> <h3> </h3> <h3>What we can offer you</h3> <p>Alongside the opportunity to work with some of the most exciting brands around the world, we’ll also prioritise your career development and help you grow your skills. We’ll empower you to make a difference, allow you to be yourself, and respect who you are.</p> <p><strong>Permanent only</strong><br>We offer a great benefits package including a discretionary bonus scheme, training opportunities, competitive pension, medical insurance, life assurance, social events, opportunities to buy and sell holidays, family friendly policies, discounts with hundreds of retailers and much more.</p> <p>Our culture thrives on our core values, designed for impact-driven individuals: Heart, Brains and Courage.</p> <p>We lead with <strong>Heart</strong>, fostering empathy and trust where genuine connections and human-centric work flourish.<br>We empower your <strong>Brains </strong>for innovation, valuing relentless curiosity and collaborative intelligence to solve complex challenges.<br>And we champion <strong>Courage</strong>, inspiring you to speak up, embrace experimentation, and advocate for bold solutions that push our thinking to be better than title: GTM Systems Lead
description: About Us We're Team Granola 👋 Granola is an AI-powered notepad for people in back-to-back meetings. What started as a better way to take notes has become a shared workspace that helps teams capture, organize, and act on what matters. We're building a product people genuinely love and are fortunate to work with many of the world's most ambitious companies. As we continue to grow, we're looking for a GTM Systems Lead to build the systems and data foundation that Sales, CS and leadership run on. About the Role We’re hiring a GTM Systems Lead to own the technology behind Granola’s commercial team as we scale. You’ll design, build and run the systems our Sales and CS teams rely on. Our current stack has served us well, but it needs to evolve as the team grows. You’ll take responsibility for how the tools fit together, what we build versus buy, and how information flows between them. This is a hands-on role. You’ll set the direction of the stack and implement the technical changes that make it work. You’ll work closely with Sales, CS and Data, and report to the Head of RevOps. You won’t be limited to administering a CRM or building isolated automations: you’ll own how the whole system works. What You’ll Do Design and evolve the GTM stack. Decide how our Sales and CS systems should fit together, what to build versus buy, and what to prioritise as we grow. Own the technical architecture of our CRM, Attio. Shape its data model, objects, workflows and integrations. You’ll be hands-on with configuration, particularly early on, but routine admin won’t be the sole focus of the role. Build and maintain integrations. Make data flow reliably across Attio and our wider toolset, including Apollo, Cal.com , Tally and Polytomic, and into the data systems used by the wider business. Own the wider toolset. Assess new tools and vendors, improve or replace what isn’t working, and make sure the stack is useful, reliable and cost-conscious. Find opportunities for automation and AI. Identify work that could be made easier for Sales and CS, and build or collaborate on solutions where they fit the priorities of the stack. Keep systems dependable. Troubleshoot problems, establish sensible governance and documentation, and partner with IT on access and security. Understand how teams work. Get close to Sales and CS workflows so the systems you build solve real problems, not just technical ones. What We’re Looking For Experience designing, building and owning systems used by a growing commercial team. Relevant hands-on experience matters more to us than a particular number of years or experience with a specific CRM. Sound judgement about system architecture, priorities and build-versus-buy decisions—and the ability to explain those decisions to non-technical colleagues. Technical depth beyond administering tools: you’ve built integrations and are comfortable working with APIs, webhooks and code. Experience with SQL, Python or JavaScript would be useful. An understanding of CRM data models, routing, enrichment and the operational work needed to keep data flowing reliably. A willingness to get into the weeds. You’re comfortable doing the implementation yourself while also thinking about how the stack should develop over time. Curiosity about AI-powered GTM workflows, with experience building them a plus rather than a prerequisite. A collaborative, low-ego approach. You can work through messy requests with Sales, CS and Data, challenge assumptions constructively, and ship solutions people can use. You don’t need to have used Attio or every tool in our stack. We’re more interested in what you’ve built, how you think about systems, and how you’d apply that experience here. About the Opportunity We are living in the most exciting time for tool builders since Engelbart's demo in 1968 and we want to assemble the best crew to build this future together. Our compensation philosophy is to hire the best people in the market and pay them accordingly with salary, variable, and equity. Lastly, we think amazing talent comes from all kinds of life journeys and experiences. If what is written above speaks to you, whether you look like a fit on paper or not, please reach out. Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Account Executive
description: We're looking for a Senior Account Executive to own full-cycle new-logo revenue for Cytix's biggest and most complex deals, in a market where most of the people you're calling haven't heard of us yet. You'll be selling a product, not a service, into CISOs, security engineers and AppSec leads who are used to being pitched by categories they already understand.
